positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Build Azure automation and infrastructure-as-code for secure, compliant, and scalable big data platforms. My work enables robust data processing pipelines end-to-end—covering identity, access, orchestration, and the underlying cloud systems that power large, multi-tenant workloads.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Frontend & backend development:
Improved the reliability and clarity of a track-changes experience used by 5,000+ customers by developing a fully tested state stream and underlying state architecture. Created a scalable approach for state-accurate notification text by extending an access-control module and implementing a factory design pattern.

positions.title: Student Software Developer Engineer
positions.description:
Frontend development:
Built UI enhancements for the Laboratory for Atmospheric and Space Physics, including a parent-grouped dropdown component for instrument and observatory filtering. Implemented and performance-tested a fully optimized dataset search feature that improved overall application speed and user experience.
